simple.meaning: שִׁבְרוֹן (shibrôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “rupture , i.e. a pang ; figuratively, ruin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שִׁבְרוֹן (H7670) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 17:18, with occurrences in Jeremiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁבְרוֹן (H7670) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שִׁבְרוֹן (H7670) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שִׁבְרוֹן (shibrôwn) / H7670 is traced through Jeremiah 17:18, Ezekiel 21:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
